_comment: Add these to the main ANDROID/package.json before building voice mode. Run: npx expo install expo-av expo-file-system

_notes.expo-av: Handles audio playback. Supports multiple concurrent Sound objects — required for the two-bot overlap design. Already included in many Expo projects; check if it's already in package.json before adding.
_notes.expo-file-system: Used by VoxtralService to write the MP3 binary from the API response to a temp cache file before handing the URI to expo-av. May already be present.
_notes.no_native_module_needed: Both packages use Expo's managed workflow and require no additional native code or ejection. They will work with the current app.json / EAS build setup.
_notes.streaming_upgrade: If streaming PCM playback is added later, react-native-track-player would be needed (it supports audio streams). That DOES require a development build. For now, expo-av + non-streaming MP3 is fine within managed workflow.
